world.title: A US Air Force veteran who loaned his Iraq war helmet to a Wyoming veterans' post spent 11 days in jail after taking it back; prosecutors later dropped the felony theft case when they could not prove
world.summary: A US Air Force veteran was arrested and jailed for 11 days after reclaiming a combat helmet he had loaned to a Wyoming veterans' post. Prosecutors later dropped felony theft charges when they could not provide sufficient evidence to support the case. The incident raised concerns about wrongful arrests and the implications for veterans' rights and property.

world.title: Three UK sisters fought their brother over a £1.6 million inheritance, including £500,000 in gold kept in a safety deposit box in India; a judge ruled the valuables belonged to the family and ordered
world.summary: Three British sisters won a court battle against their brother regarding their late father's £1.6 million estate. A judge ruled that the estate, which included £300,000 in cash savings and £500,000 in gold stored in India, belonged to the family. The ruling dismissed the brother's claims, affirming the sisters' rights to the inheritance.

world.title: In 1965, Merle Thornton chained herself to a Brisbane bar after women were denied the right to drink in public bars; 61 years later, a life-sized statue in Brisbane honours the feminist activist for h
world.summary: Merle Thornton AM, known for chaining herself to a Brisbane bar in 1965 to protest the ban on women drinking in public bars, has been commemorated with a life-sized statue in the city. This tribute recognizes her significant contribution to the feminist movement and the ongoing fight for women's rights in Australia, marking 61 years since her protest.

business.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
business.summary: Dreamteam, a startup founded by former Freshworks executives, has raised $53 million to compete with Salesforce and HubSpot using its AI-native CRM. The company has attracted over 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses transitioning from established CRM platforms. Dreamteam aims to leverage AI technology to disrupt a market dominated by longstanding competitors.

business.title: Mankind licenses Lung cancer drug ensartinib from China’s Betta Pharmaceuticals
business.summary: Mankind Pharma has secured exclusive rights to commercialize the lung cancer drug ensartinib from China's Betta Pharmaceuticals in India. The Delhi-based company will pay an undisclosed upfront fee, milestone payments, and royalties based on net sales. Ensartinib has received approval from both the US FDA and China's National Medical Products Administration for its therapeutic use.

business.title: Breaking: Canada CPI rose by 3.1% YoY in October
business.summary: Canada's Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased by 3.1% year-over-year in October, maintaining the same rate as September but falling short of market expectations. On a monthly basis, prices rose by 0.2%. This continued inflationary trend reflects ongoing economic pressures within the country, as the CPI figures indicate persistent price increases across various sectors.

technology.title: Mass Effect Fans Once Again Send Cupcakes to EA Headquarter as a Form of Protest
technology.summary: Mass Effect fans are sending cupcakes to EA headquarters to protest the planned shutdown of BioWare, the studio responsible for the franchise. This initiative began after EA announced in October 2026 that it would close BioWare, prompting fans to express their desire to save the beloved sci-fi series. The gesture serves as a nostalgic homage to the franchise's legacy.

technology.title: After certificate-key flaw, CERT-In flags fresh vulnerability in eMudhra
technology.summary: CERT-In has identified a new vulnerability in eMudhra's emBridge software, which could potentially expose file and directory names on users' computers. However, the flaw does not compromise the content files, cryptographic keys, or hardware token PINs. This alert follows a previous incident involving a certificate-key issue, highlighting ongoing security concerns related to eMudhra's software.

technology.title: Vivo X500 series to launch on November 26: Expected price, camera, specs and more
technology.summary: Vivo will launch its X500 series in India on November 26, featuring three flagship smartphones: the X500, X500 Pro, and Pro Max, along with the Watch GT 2. The series includes a 200-megapixel periscope camera and large batteries. Prices are expected to exceed Rs 2 lakh, following their initial launch in China in September.

sports.title: Which cricket teams can qualify for the LA 2028 Olympics and how?
sports.summary: Cricket will return to the Olympics in 2028, featuring six men's and six women's teams competing in T20 format. A qualification process has been announced, allowing eight teams from each gender to vie for medals. The final qualification will occur shortly before the Games, marking a significant step for cricket's inclusion in the Los Angeles Olympics.

sports.title: Merab Dvalishvili Apologizes To Usman Nurmagomedov’s Friend Akhmed Gadzhimagomedov After Abu Dhabi Brawl
sports.summary: Merab Dvalishvili has issued an apology to Akhmed Gadzhimagomedov for insulting his family, aiming to resolve their ongoing feud. This follows a brawl in Abu Dhabi that involved Usman Nurmagomedov's team. Dvalishvili's apology seeks to mend relations after the incident, which has drawn significant attention and controversy within the mixed martial arts community.

sports.title: Prestwidge five-for helps end Stars' losing run in dramatic fashion
sports.summary: Melbourne Stars ended their five-match losing streak with a six-run victory over Sydney Thunder at Drummoyne Oval. Defending a total of 120, the Stars relied on Georgia Prestwidge, who took five wickets, causing a late collapse in the Thunder's innings. Despite needing 33 runs from 33 balls with six wickets in hand, Thunder fell short, losing by six runs.

health.title: The rise and fall of a high-risk bacterial clone
health.summary: Vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium has been designated by the World Health Organization as a top priority pathogen for 2024, surpassing MRSA. This bacterium can transfer resistance genes across humans, animals, and the environment. A recent study in Genome Medicine explores the phenomenon of clonal replacement in hospitals, investigating why certain high-risk bacterial clones eventually lose their competitive advantage.

health.title: NewEra Hospitals Inaugurates Dedicated NICU Facility In Navi Mumbai
health.summary: NewEra Hospitals has inaugurated a dedicated Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in Vashi, Navi Mumbai. This facility aims to enhance specialized healthcare services for premature and critically ill newborns. Equipped with advanced medical infrastructure and trained staff, the NICU is designed to provide essential care, addressing the needs of vulnerable infants and supporting their families during critical times.

health.title: How ML predicts mortality risk after heart attack
health.summary: Machine learning models have demonstrated the ability to predict mortality rates in hospitals and within six months following ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI), a severe type of heart attack. This finding was presented at the ESC Digital & AI Summit 2026. Annually, over two million individuals globally experience STEMI, which results from complete blockage of a coronary artery.

science.title: NASA's Voyager 1 Nears One-Light-Day Milestone, Defying Limits of Space Exploration
science.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 is approaching a significant milestone, nearing a distance of one light-day from Earth, demonstrating nearly five decades of space exploration. On October 18, 2026, the spacecraft lost contact with NASA's Deep Space Network, which consists of large antennas. This event marks a critical point in the mission, highlighting the challenges of long-term space communication.

science.title: CRISPR Tool Unlocks Faster Breeding for Pearl Millet’s Grass Relatives
science.summary: Chinese scientists have developed the first haploid-induction system for Pennisetum alopecuroides, a wild grass related to pearl millet. Utilizing CRISPR gene editing, this tool aims to enhance breeding efficiency for pearl millet’s relatives. The advancement could significantly improve genetic research and crop development, potentially benefiting agricultural practices and food security in the future.

science.title: A planet has vanished from sight. Scientists say it could take 50 years to return
science.summary: A planet, similar in size to Jupiter and located nearly 1,000 light years away, has vanished from astronomers' view. Researchers from the American Astronomical Society published a study in the Astrophysical Journal Letters, suggesting that the planet's orbit may have gradually changed. It could take 30 to 50 years for telescopes to detect the planet again.

entertainment.title: Ramya Krishnan Says She And Krishna Vamsi Are '100% Married' And 'Happily Living In 2 Different Cities'
entertainment.summary: Actor Ramya Krishnan addressed rumors about her marriage to Krishna Vamsi, confirming they are "100% married" but reside in different cities. During an appearance on the Raw Talks with VK podcast, she expressed her belief that marriage is an overrated institution in a relationship. Krishnan emphasized their commitment while highlighting their unique living arrangements.

entertainment.title: HanuMan Actor Teja Sajja Gets Engaged In Intimate Ceremony In Hyderabad, See Pics
entertainment.summary: Telugu actor Teja Sajja, known for his role in Hanu-Man, got engaged in a private ceremony at the Taj Krishna Hotel in Hyderabad on November 16. Although he has not released official photos, images of the couple have circulated on social media. The event was attended by several notable figures from the Telugu film industry.

entertainment.title: Sai Pallavi reveals her parents' reaction after she cut her hair for Dhanush and Mammootty starrer 'O.M'; Father in disbelief asked, 'Pallavi, this is a wig, right?'
entertainment.summary: Sai Pallavi cut her hair for her role in the upcoming film 'O.M', directed by Rajkumar Periasamy. This significant change surprised her family, particularly her father, who expressed disbelief, asking if her new look was a wig. The actress's transformation highlights her commitment to embodying her character in the film, which also stars Dhanush and Mammootty.
